nodes.norm_label: email verification required to create links

nodes.rationale: Every moderation change needs a reason and is recorded.

nodes.label: Report status change (independent from link block)
nodes.norm_label: report status change (independent from link block)
nodes.rationale: Report status changes never block/unblock the link, keeping actions separate.

nodes.rationale: Counts include repeats and bots, not unique visitors; country/device are estimates.

nodes.label: Edit conflict notice (changed elsewhere)
nodes.rationale: Shows latest saved version and keeps user's edits so they choose to overwrite or keep.

nodes.norm_label: integration tests against real postgresql/redis/mailpit (fail, never skip)

nodes.label: Guest short-link flow (7-day expiry, not editable/trackable)
nodes.norm_label: guest short-link flow (7-day expiry, not editable/trackable)
nodes.rationale: Guests get links without account; editing and tracking reserved for signed-up users to drive signup.

nodes.label: Human verification challenge (dev mock)
nodes.rationale: Anonymous creation gated by bot check; dev mock does no real verification.

nodes.label: Google account linking with password re-confirmation
nodes.norm_label: google account linking with password re-confirmation
nodes.rationale: Connecting Google requires proof of both accounts.

nodes.norm_label: code allocator (advisory lock + on conflict, 8-char base62)
nodes.rationale: pg_advisory_xact_lock(1001) per code ensures one winner; reserved aliases return the same 409 so the list cannot be probed.

nodes.label: Destination URL rules (no private IPs, credentials, localhost)
nodes.norm_label: destination url rules (no private ips, credentials, localhost)

nodes.label: Fixed-window Redis rate limiter (HMAC subjects, fail closed)
nodes.norm_label: fixed-window redis rate limiter (hmac subjects, fail closed)
nodes.rationale: If Redis cannot count, 503 rather than unlimited; raw IPs/emails never reach Redis; up to 2x limit at window boundary accepted.

nodes.label: Registered link management (versioned ETags, keyset pagination)
nodes.norm_label: registered link management (versioned etags, keyset pagination)

nodes.label: Session store and auth guards (session, csrf, user, verified, admin, recentAuth)
nodes.norm_label: session store and auth guards (session, csrf, user, verified, admin, recentauth)
nodes.rationale: Rotate on sign-in to prevent fixation; fail closed on Redis failure; re-read status and session_version from PostgreSQL on every protected request.

nodes.label: Open question: challenged guest spends two of five hourly attempts
nodes.norm_label: open question: challenged guest spends two of five hourly attempts

nodes.label: Opaque HttpOnly cookie sessions stored in Redis
nodes.norm_label: opaque httponly cookie sessions stored in redis
nodes.rationale: Account status and session version re-checked in PostgreSQL so suspension and password-reset revocation take effect immediately.

nodes.label: Optimistic concurrency via ETag/If-Match
nodes.rationale: A stale edit is rejected (412) rather than silently overwriting a newer one.

nodes.label: Non-disclosing report confirmation (privacy)
nodes.rationale: Does not reveal whether a link was found, to protect privacy.

nodes.norm_label: t34 concurrency, authorisation and failure handling evidence

nodes.label: Principle: Tell the truth
nodes.rationale: Never imply something works, is live, unique or guaranteed when it is not; mocks and estimates are labelled because the project is CV evidence judged as a real product.

nodes.label: Modular monolith (API + worker from one codebase)
nodes.norm_label: modular monolith (api + worker from one codebase)

nodes.label: Redirect failure pages (byte-identical inactive page, strict CSP)
nodes.norm_label: redirect failure pages (byte-identical inactive page, strict csp)

nodes.label: Redirect resolver (one statement on primary, 302/404/410/503)
nodes.rationale: Depends only on PostgreSQL, never Redis; one generic 410 for all inactive reasons; requests shed at pool.waitingCount >= 50.

nodes.label: Principle: Changes take effect now
nodes.rationale: What the owner saves is what the next visitor gets; motivates no redirect caching.

nodes.label: Principle: Reveal nothing that is not yours
nodes.norm_label: principle: reveal nothing that is not yours
nodes.rationale: Confirmations read the same whatever exists, preventing account/link enumeration; owners never see moderation internals.

nodes.label: Redirects read PostgreSQL primary on every request (no cache)
nodes.norm_label: redirects read postgresql primary on every request (no cache)
nodes.rationale: A cache would make edits and disables visible only after a delay, breaking confirmed requirement D12.

nodes.label: Analytics views (CSS chart, bounded polling, UTC ranges)
nodes.norm_label: analytics views (css chart, bounded polling, utc ranges)

nodes.label: Analytics worker (consumer group, ack after commit, dead letters)
nodes.norm_label: analytics worker (consumer group, ack after commit, dead letters)

nodes.label: Click capture (Redis Stream clicks:v1, bounded, circuit breaker)
nodes.norm_label: click capture (redis stream clicks:v1, bounded, circuit breaker)
nodes.rationale: 302 sent first; capture never blocks or throws; loss is counted rather than retried.

nodes.label: Encrypted email outbox (AES-256-GCM, at-least-once delivery)
nodes.rationale: Token and email written in one transaction; FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED lease; duplicate email possible, losing a committed one is not.

nodes.label: Owner analytics API (REPEATABLE READ snapshot, string counters)
nodes.norm_label: owner analytics api (repeatable read snapshot, string counters)

nodes.label: Retention jobs and pipeline health (heartbeat, healthy/delayed/degraded/unknown)
nodes.norm_label: retention jobs and pipeline health (heartbeat, healthy/delayed/degraded/unknown)

nodes.label: API conventions (error envelope, no-store, request IDs, CSRF, rate limits)
nodes.norm_label: api conventions (error envelope, no-store, request ids, csrf, rate limits)

nodes.label: Readiness checks PostgreSQL only
nodes.rationale: Redirects (critical path) do not need Redis; sign-in and creation fail closed with 503; Redis alerting belongs to T37 monitoring.

nodes.label: Asynchronous analytics pipeline
nodes.rationale: Redirects publish an event and return immediately; worker dedupes by event ID in a transaction so crash-and-replay never double-counts.

nodes.label: Explicit Google account linking + recent authentication (T16)
nodes.norm_label: explicit google account linking + recent authentication (t16)
nodes.rationale: Both identities must be proven; matching emails never link anything.

nodes.label: Admin moderation APIs (atomic audit, advisory lock 1005)
nodes.norm_label: admin moderation apis (atomic audit, advisory lock 1005)
nodes.rationale: Change and admin_audit row in one transaction; self-suspension and last-active-admin blocked.

nodes.label: Principle: Every power leaves a record
nodes.norm_label: principle: every power leaves a record
nodes.rationale: Admin actions need a reason, recent confirmation and an audit entry; roles never granted through the app.

nodes.label: Argon2id password hashing + no account discovery
nodes.norm_label: argon2id password hashing + no account discovery
nodes.rationale: Dummy hash verified for unknown emails so timing matches; register/resend always 202.

nodes.label: Measured analytics freshness (p95 ~0.59 s, light load)
nodes.norm_label: measured analytics freshness (p95 ~0.59 s, light load)

nodes.norm_label: overload shedding finding (pool 10 sheds at 50-100 concurrent; fix in t35)

nodes.label: Code principles D17 (SOLID with restraint, no unhandled errors, async/await)
nodes.norm_label: code principles d17 (solid with restraint, no unhandled errors, async/await)
nodes.rationale: Abstractions only when a second implementation exists; dependencies injected so tests can pass real test databases.

nodes.label: routes -> controller -> service -> repository layering
nodes.rationale: Owner request for readability; file suffix always shows the layer; only repositories talk SQL.
